trance.short: Melodic builds, emotional breakdowns, progressive journeys and classic trance energy.
trance.story: Trance Tuesday gives the music time to breathe: long builds, real breakdowns, uplifting melodies, progressive movement and classics that still stop the room for a moment.

eurodance.short: Hooks, rap verses, female vocals, piano riffs, synths and European dance-floor energy.
eurodance.story: Eurodance is two hours of the genre itself: huge hooks, female vocals, rap verses, piano riffs, synths, classics, forgotten gems and the European dance records that carried the sound forward.

retro.short: Real chart history across pop, dance, rock, soul and everything else that became a hit.
retro.story: Retro Hits is the chart time machine: big hits, forgotten hits and small stories from 10, 20, 30, 40 and 50 years ago — with room to stop on one year and explore what people were actually listening to.

nudisco.short: Classic disco DNA with modern production, funk, basslines, edits and sophisticated house grooves.
nudisco.story: Nu Disco stays inside the groove: modern disco, funk-driven house, basslines, strings, guitars, synths, edits and remixes with old soul and contemporary production.

weekend.short: Forward-facing EDM and house with fresh releases, raidtrain energy and FOLSOE Top 20 movement.
weekend.story: Weekend looks forward: fresh EDM, house, vocal house, club tracks and selected movement from the FOLSOE Top 20 — ideal for Friday nights, Saturday sessions and raidtrains.

fredagsbar.short: Friday music without a genre committee: dance, pop, house, disco, classics and whatever the room needs.
fredagsbar.story: Fredagsbar is intentionally broad: dance, pop, house, disco, Eurodance, classics and requests. The music follows the room, the chat and the general condition of Friday evening.

morning.badge: RADIO HITS · DANCE POP · GOOD COMPANY
morning.short: A bright morning blend of familiar radio hits, pop, dance-pop, Nu Disco and easy-start energy.
morning.story: Good Morning Twitch is built for waking up rather than peak-time club pressure: radio hits, pop, dance-pop, Nu Disco, familiar favourites and whatever makes the morning move in the right direction.

popup.short: Pop, dance, house, rock, retro, trance and anything else that makes sense at that exact moment.
popup.story: POP UP has no genre rules. The music can move through pop, dance, house, rock, disco, trance, Eurodance, new releases and old favourites depending on the moment and the chat.
